name: user-key
description: A complete head-and-shoulders avatar beside a complete key with two teeth.
useCase: Manage account credentials or authentication keys.
misuse: Label the account action or status explicitly; the symbol alone does not establish identity or permission.

16.reason: The full head uses the shared avatar size; both complete shoulders and the separate account marker retain clear gaps.

24.reason: The head uses the shared interface avatar radius; both complete shoulders and the separate marker retain generous clear gaps.
